scope: Persistent stdio adapter to the current local service. Native macOS payload replacement is locally qualified; Windows MSI continuous-process replacement is not qualified.

runtimeInventory.coverage: Installed bin executables/libraries and both component VERSION files, after dependency fixups. Project code, profiles, indexes and history are not code-cohort members.
runtimeInventory.bounds: 128 files, 128 MiB per file, 512 MiB total. Relative normalized paths, exact portable spelling, unique names, no links or shared writable code. Homebrew's shin-monitor launcher is not service runtime code.
runtimeInventory.ownership: The original prefix locator and data-home identity remain pinned. Native installations also retain the same owned control directory, recorded home, complete installation state and receipt-bound outer manifest. Only the declared Homebrew opt locator can change its physical package prefix.
runtimeInventory.cache: Successful full SHA-256 verification is cached only in process. Each request checks the manifest, runtime inventory and file identities, sizes, ownership/modes, mtime and ctime. A changed stamp triggers full verification; restoring mtime alone cannot preserve a tampered cache entry. Recheck after retrieval withholds results crossing a runtime change.

request.transport: Existing private shin.local-rpc.v1 socket or pipe with peer/endpoint identity checks.

mcp_runtime.runtime_sha256: SHA-256 of the verified runtime inventory

request.versions: Requests and responses must exactly match Observer and Core versions from the verified current runtime, not values supplied by a model or learned from an untrusted service refusal.
request.service: At startup the service verifies its runtime inventory against its compiled versions and captures its digest. It rejects any different mcp_runtime before project execution. Normal CLI, resident workers and installer-control version fences remain unchanged.
request.admission: An opaque verified-runtime object is created only by the bridge. Tool arguments cannot choose versions, runtime digests, roots or homes. The handoff path cannot stop or control the service.
request.replay: No automatic replay, including checkpoints. An in-flight cohort change withholds the result; resume saved task state before retrying a checkpoint write.

compatibility.adapterFingerprint: CMake fingerprints the code retained in a persistent adapter: MCP handlers/SDK selection, stdio, service client/envelope, session framing, scope/lifecycle admission and attempt journaling. A different adapter_contract_sha256 requires reconnecting even when the declared protocol remains v1. Core, service business logic and UI source versions are not this contract. The fingerprint is exposed by shin-ce --version for diagnostics.
compatibility.adapter: The persistent adapter owns bounded MCP framing, its initialized tool schemas, allowed-root/home/lifecycle admission, correlation framing and attempt journaling. Retrieval, freshness, readiness, policy and checkpoint/resume validation execute in the current service.
compatibility.breaks: Bump the runtime protocol for incompatible local-RPC fields, MCP tools or argument schemas, selector/snapshot framing, session-draft/correlation framing or adapter-owned journal formats. Do not label an incompatible change v1 merely to avoid a reconnect.
compatibility.cutover: Adapters released before this mechanism require one reconnect. Build-tree/unpackaged adapters without a runtime inventory keep exact compiled-version behavior. No live installation, binding or client config is migrated by an MCP read.
compatibility.failure: Unknown protocol requires reconnecting only the integration. Mixed/damaged runtimes and service identity mismatches require update review. No fallback index, profile change, compatibility parser or disabled version check is introduced.
